description: CF_HTML behind a UTF-8 BOM whose offsets count the BOM's three bytes
notes: The blob starts with EF BB BF, so the first header line reads <BOM>Version:1.0 and its "key" is not ASCII. A parser that stops the header scan there rejects the whole payload as ErrorKind::BadMagic. The mark is skipped for line reading and counted for every offset: StartHTML equals header_len, BOM included.
